Went to see Beautifica and it felt like stepping completely outside of reality for a moment.

In that space, everything got quiet. My mind slowed down. My heart opened up. I was able to sort through so many internal things and what I walked away with was simple and powerful. I am deeply blessed. I am on the right path. I have the right people in my life. And most of all, God has had me this entire time.

I realized I finally understand what true love actually is. It is not just a feeling or a spark. It is an all consuming sense of peace. It is safety. It is the desire to become better, grow deeper, invest more fully in life, and show up with intention. It feels grounded, calm, and expansive all at once.

Sometimes things have to fall apart. Sometimes God has to prune away the bullshit and the things holding you down so that true love, happiness, and purpose can actually blossom. And when it does, you can feel it in your bones.

Tonight was a reminder that I am held, guided, and exactly where I am meant to be.
🙏✨
